notes: Gnarled, moss- and lichen-draped cloud-forest tree in two forms. The large tree is about 9.2 m tall with a crown about 9.8 m across; the small, wind-sheared tree is about 5.2 m tall and 7.5 m long. Sizes come from the 1 m bar (about 62 px). The 'side' views are taken as seen from -x, so the trunk lean and the crown run toward +z. The top views seem drawn at about 0.72x the side-view scale, so their depth (x) comes from the top-view aspect. The three-quarter view is left out.
